title: 第28章 乱葬岗，煞气淬炼！
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
距离京城一年一度的灯火节，只剩不到半个月。

    天牢里的气氛悄然发生着变化。

    连日来那种紧绷肃杀的压抑感逐渐消散，狱卒们当班时的闲聊也多了起来。

    休息室里，正中央燃着一个铁皮炭盆。

    老王抓了一把瓜子，边磕边吐瓜子皮。

    “听说了没？六扇门那位林捕头，在审讯室里熬了三天三夜，终于把张家那位大少爷的嘴给撬开了。”

    旁边一名年轻狱卒探过头，满脸好奇。

    “查出什么了？张玉龙可是户部员外郎的公子，林捕头真敢下死手？”

    老王嗤笑。

    “那林捕头是个狠角色。听说张玉龙起初嘴硬，死活不开口。林捕头二话不说，直接上刑。

    张家大少爷哪里受过这种罪，当场尿了裤子，竹筒倒豆子全招了。”

    老王压低嗓门，凑近了几分。

    “张玉龙交代了所有，林捕头已经带人去踩点了，准备来个连锅端。”

    年轻狱卒咋舌。

    “在灯火节左右审出消息？那可是京城最热闹的时候，街上人挤人，他们倒是会挑日子。”

    "就是苦了我们了，咱们知道内部消息，现在被禁足在这里，也不知道什么时候可以出去放风。"

    ……

    陈然坐在自己的休息室。

    手里拿着一块破布，慢条斯理地擦拭着横在膝盖上的黑铁长刀。

    以他现在的境界，就算隔着几十米远。

    老王等人的闲聊依旧清晰地落在他的耳朵里。

    林琬抓谁，朝堂上怎么斗，与他无关。

    只要有新犯人送进天牢，让他按时收租就行。

    他的视线落在手中的长刀上。

    经历了境界突破的煞气暴动后，这把无名黑刀表面发生了一些变化。

    原本发灰的铁锈上，多出了几条极细的暗红色纹路。

    手指从纹路上拂过，能感觉到一丝异常的温热。

    陈然停下手里的动作。

    这东西有古怪。

    天牢里有个现成的懂行之人。

    陈然将长刀插回刀鞘，起身提起地上的木桶。

    ……

    丁字号牢房的走廊里阴暗潮湿，墙壁上渗出水珠。

    江梦璃靠坐在角落的干草堆上。

    身上穿着单薄的囚服，手腕和脚踝上的玄铁锁链拖在地上。

    这里打扫的很干净，根本没有半分天牢该有的恶劣。

    自从上一次红莲魔教试探之后，两方人马都很有默契的没有再动手。
content_en:
There is less than half a month left before the capital's annual Lantern Festival.

    The atmosphere in the sky prison quietly changed.

    The tense and depressing feeling of the past few days gradually dissipated, and the jailers chatted more and more while on duty.

    In the lounge, an iron charcoal pot was burning in the center.

    Lao Wang grabbed a handful of melon seeds and chewed them while spitting out the skin.

    "Have you heard? Mr. Lin, the head of Liumen, stayed in the interrogation room for three days and three nights, and finally pried open the mouth of the eldest young master of the Zhang family."

    A young jailer next to him looked over, his face full of curiosity.

    "What did you find out? Zhang Yulong is the son of a member of the Ministry of Household Affairs. How dare Mr. Lin kill him?"

    Lao Wang sneered.

    "Then Capt. Lin is a ruthless character. I heard that Zhang Yulong was tough-talking at first and refused to speak. Capt. Lin didn't say anything and went straight to execution.

    The eldest young man of the Zhang family had never experienced such a crime. He peed his pants on the spot and poured beans through a bamboo tube. "

    Lao Wang lowered his voice and leaned a little closer.

    "Zhang Yulong has explained everything, and Capt. Lin has already taken people to check out the spots, and is ready to have a meal."

    The young jailer was speechless.

    "Censoring information around the Lantern Festival? That's the busiest time in the capital. The streets are crowded, so they pick the day."

    "It's just hard on us. We know the inside information, but now we are banned here. We don't know when we can go out for fun."

    …

    Chen Ran was sitting in his lounge.

    Holding a rag in his hand, he slowly wiped the long black iron knife across his knees.

    With his current state, even if they are dozens of meters away.

    The chatter of Lao Wang and others still clearly fell on his ears.

    Who Lin Wan arrests and how they fight in the court have nothing to do with him.

    As long as a new prisoner is sent to the sky jail and he is asked to collect rent on time, it will be fine.

    His eyes fell on the long knife in his hand.

    After experiencing the riot of evil energy that broke through the realm, some changes occurred on the surface of this nameless black knife.

    There were a few very fine dark red lines on the originally gray rust.

    When you brush your fingers over the lines, you can feel an unusual warmth.

    Chen Ran stopped what he was doing.

    There's something weird about this thing.

    There is a ready-made knowledgeable person in the prison.

    Chen Ran put the long knife back into the scabbard, stood up and lifted the barrel on the ground.

    …

    The corridor of the T-shaped cell was dark and damp, with drops of water seeping from the walls.

    Jiang Mengli sat on the haystack in the corner.

    He was wearing a thin prison uniform, and the black iron chains on his wrists and ankles were dragging on the ground.

    The place is very clean and not at all as bad as a prison.

    Since the last trial by the Red Lotus Demon Cult, both parties had a tacit understanding and did not take action again.
title_en: Chapter 28 Mass graves, tempering the evil spirit!
